title: CPAP Mask Leak vs Apnea Burden
dataSources: Oura stress and recovery (`oura:stress`), CPAP therapy sessions (`cpap:session`), oral thermometer readings (`thermometer:reading`), and body-composition scale snapshots (`bodycomp:reading`).
app: Personal health telemetry from Oura, OSCAR CPAP exports, oral thermometer readings, and smart body-composition scales sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cpap:session
| stats avg(mask_leak_lpm) as avg_mask_leak_lpm avg(apnea_events) as avg_apnea_events by mask_type
| sort 0 - avg_mask_leak_lpm
description: Ranks mask typess by mask leak and apnea burden.
value: Leak burden often travels with worse therapy quality, and ranking by mask type helps focus troubleshooting.
implementation: Send mask leak and apnea burden events to `index=personal` and keep `mask_type` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of mask leak and apnea burden by mask types.
grandmaExplanation: It totals which mask typess stand out most for mask leak and apnea burden.
